summary: Jira intake loop retries every 60 s forever when Jira is unset or failing
description:
Source: DFMEA 2026-11-04 (F15). Confirmed: `_jira_intake_loop` sleeps a fixed `POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 60` and logs each failure.

This matters more now: with the local tracker (ANVIL-56) Jira is usually not configured at all, and the log fills with failures that hide real errors.

**Fix:**

* Don't start the Jira loop when the tracker is local or Jira isn't configured, and say so once at startup.
* When Jira is configured but failing, back off exponentially (to 15 min), log state changes once, and recover on success.

**Acceptance:** tests for unconfigured (no loop, one log line) and failing then recovering (backoff, then normal interval).

comments.body: [devin] PR #84 up: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/84 — lifespan starts the loop only when a source exists (tickets dir / Jira creds / injected), one 'intake disabled' line otherwise; poll failure backs off 60s→2× capped at 15min, logs first failure + recovery only. 3 tests green.
